name: agntree
displayName: Agntree — Session & Git Worktree Manager for Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Pi
description: Manage Claude Code, Codex, opencode, and Pi sessions in one sidebar, in VS Code and Cursor. Run AI coding agents in parallel on git worktrees, then resume, fork, and find any session, and get notified when an agent needs you.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Start managing your Claude Code, opencode, Codex, and Pi sessions across folders, repositories, and worktrees.

[Add Local Folder or Repository](command:agntree.addRepository)
[Clone from GitHub](command:agntree.cloneRepository)

Add any local folder, or clone a repository from GitHub to get started.

Select a worktree, folder, or session to view uncommitted changes.

Click the diff icon on any file to view side-by-side comparison.
Select a worktree, folder, or session to browse its files.

Describe what you worked on and a coding agent finds the session among your past ones, in any folder.

[Find Session](command:agntree.findSession)

The agent reads your session transcripts, so what it reads goes to its model provider.

enumDescriptions: The New Session button opens a menu of every installed agent.
The New Session button starts a Claude Code session.
The New Session button starts an opencode session.
The New Session button starts a Codex session.
The New Session button starts a Pi session.
agntree.defaultHarness.markdownDescription: The agent the **New Session** button (`+`) on a worktree or folder starts with one click. Every agent stays in the row's right-click **New Session** menu, and New Session asks which agent to use when the default one is not installed. Where the session opens is set by `#agntree.defaultSessionSurface#`.

enumDescriptions: Sessions open in a terminal running the agent CLI.
Sessions open in the agent's own VS Code extension panel (Claude Code and Codex). Agents without one, and sessions the panel cannot open, use the terminal.
agntree.defaultSessionSurface.markdownDescription: Where a session opens when you click its row or start a new one. The **In Terminal** and **In UI** commands in the New Session menu always override this.

agntree.autoImport.enabled.markdownDescription: Show sessions you started outside Agntree — in a plain terminal or in an agent's VS Code panel — as rows under their worktree. Turn off to list only sessions started from Agntree; **Import Existing Sessions…** still adds others by hand.

agntree.autoImport.retentionDays.markdownDescription: Session rows leave the tree after this many days without activity, whether they were imported or started in Agntree. Starred sessions always stay. Only the row is removed: the agent keeps the conversation, and **Import Existing Sessions…** or **Find Session…** brings it back.

agntree.notifications.enabled.markdownDescription: Notify you about sessions you are not looking at. This is the main switch: turn it off and the settings below have no effect.

agntree.notifications.onTurnEnd.markdownDescription: Notify when an agent finishes responding. Works for every agent. Needs `#agntree.notifications.enabled#`.

agntree.notifications.onNeedsInput.markdownDescription: Notify when a Claude Code session is waiting on you, for example at a permission prompt. Claude Code only. Needs `#agntree.notifications.enabled#`.

agntree.notifications.nativeBanner.markdownDescription: macOS only: also show a system banner while VS Code is in the background. The banner cannot be clicked; the notification inside VS Code has the **Open** button. Needs `#agntree.notifications.enabled#`.

enumDescriptions: Claude Code runs the search with read-only file tools.
Codex runs the search in its read-only sandbox.
Pi runs the search with its read-only read, grep, find, and ls tools.
agntree.sessionSearch.harness.markdownDescription: The agent that runs **Find Session…**. It must be installed. Sessions from every installed agent are searched whichever one runs the search; opencode's sessions are searched too, but opencode cannot run it. Changing this clears `#agntree.sessionSearch.model#` and `#agntree.sessionSearch.effort#`.

agntree.sessionSearch.model.markdownDescription: The model **Find Session…** uses, written the way that agent's CLI names it (for example `sonnet` for Claude Code). Leave empty to use the model the agent is already configured with. **Find Session Settings…** offers a list to pick from.

enumDescriptions: Use the reasoning effort the agent is already configured with.
agntree.sessionSearch.effort.markdownDescription: How hard the agent thinks during **Find Session…**. Higher is slower and costs more. A level the chosen agent does not support is ignored.

agntree.sessionSearch.alwaysShowView.markdownDescription: Show the **Find Session** view in the Agntree sidebar all the time. Turn off to show it only after your first search.

agntree.autoSwitchWorkspaceFolder.markdownDescription: When you select a worktree or session in another repository, make that folder the one VS Code has open, so the Explorer, search, and source control follow it. VS Code restarts its extensions on each switch, which shows as a brief flicker. With this off, use **Open in This Window** on a worktree's right-click menu.

agntree.focusOnStartup.markdownDescription: Open the Agntree sidebar when VS Code starts, instead of the File Explorer.

agntree.harnessCommands.claude.markdownDescription: The command that starts Claude Code. Change it when `claude` is not on your PATH (use the full path) or you launch it through a wrapper. Reload the window after changing it.

agntree.harnessCommands.opencode.markdownDescription: The command that starts opencode. Change it when `opencode` is not on your PATH (use the full path) or you launch it through a wrapper. Reload the window after changing it.

agntree.harnessCommands.codex.markdownDescription: The command that starts Codex. Change it when `codex` is not on your PATH (use the full path) or you launch it through a wrapper. Reload the window after changing it.

agntree.harnessCommands.pi.markdownDescription: The command that starts Pi. Change it when `pi` is not on your PATH (use the full path) or you launch it through a wrapper. Reload the window after changing it.

view/item/context.when: view == agntree.filesView && (viewItem == folder || viewItem == file) && agntree.hasFileClipboard
